caseNameFull: BILIK v. STRASSHEIM, SHERIFF OF COOK COUNTY, ILLINOIS
syllabus: Appeal from judgment of Circuit Court, denying petition for writ of •habeas corpus where petitioner was held under process of the state court, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. There was no certificate of probable cause for allowing the appeal as required by the act of March 10, 1908, c. 76, 35 Stat. 40.1
summary: APPEAL FROM THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS.
attorneys: Mr. Francis E* Hinckley and Mr. S. S. Gregory for appellant., Mr. John J. Healy, State Attorney, Mr. Erasmus C. Ldndley and Mr. James J. Barbour for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction.
